introHtml: Custom camping wine glasses combine the sophistication of stemware with the rugged durability needed for the outdoors. Unlike standard wine glasses, these tumblers are built to withstand bumps and drops, making them ideal for corporate retreats, outdoor trade shows, or employee appreciation gifts. The 10 oz MiiR® Vacuum Insulated Wine Tumbler keeps drinks at the perfect temperature while showcasing your logo. Choose from stainless steel or shatterproof acrylic options, and decorate with screen printing or laser engraving for a lasting impression.
